# permio_permission (Data Source)

Looks up a permission by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "permio_permission" "read" {
  name = "document.read"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Permission name.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the permission.
- `id` (String) Permission ID.
